# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

OpenTopoX is committed to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free
community for everyone.

We expect all participants to treat others with empathy and professionalism,
whether they are opening issues, reviewing pull requests, discussing designs,
or maintaining releases.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful of different experience levels, backgrounds, and viewpoints.
- Give constructive feedback and keep technical disagreement focused on the
  work.
- Assume good intent, ask clarifying questions, and make room for newcomers.
- Respect project maintainers' time, review process, and security disclosure
  rules.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, threats, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Sexualized language or imagery in project spaces.
- Personal attacks, sustained disruption, or bad-faith demands.
- Publishing private information without explicit permission.
- Publicly disclosing security vulnerabilities before maintainers have had a
  reasonable opportunity to respond.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in all OpenTopoX project spaces, including GitHub
issues, pull requests, discussions, releases, documentation, community chat, and
events where someone represents the project.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, reject contributions, temporarily
limit participation, or ban participants who violate this code of conduct.

Reports should be sent through the private channels listed in
[SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) when they involve vulnerabilities, private
information, or safety concerns. For ordinary conduct issues, contact the
maintainers listed in [MAINTAINERS.md](./MAINTAINERS.md).

Maintainers will review reports in good faith, protect reporter privacy where
possible, and respond with actions proportionate to the situation.
